people.name: Azmon
people.line: Place on the southern border of Judah.

people.name: Brook_of_Egypt
people.line: Southwestern boundary of the Promised Land

translations.web: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.
translations.bsb: where it will turn from Azmon, join the Brook of Egypt, and end at the Sea.
translations.kjv: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
translations.asv: and the border shall turn about from Azmon unto the brook of Egypt, and the goings out thereof shall be at the sea.
